// ------------------------------------------------------------
// New MEC Trooper groups:
// - InterpGroup_32 copies MecTrooper1 (original InterpGroup_15)
// - InterpGroup_33 copies MecTrooper2 (original InterpGroup_16)
// - SeqVar_Object_78/79 expose MecTrooper6/MecTrooper7
// - SeqVar_Named_60/61 resolve those names
//
// - Use new slot 6/7 positions and headings
// ------------------------------------------------------------
